verdict.rationale: The evidence shows PagerDuty offers Status Pages that give real-time operational insights and let users communicate updates "securely" (pagerduty-docs-10, pagerduty-docs-17). Nothing documents private or internal pages, audience restriction, or access control for customer-specific or employee-only viewers, which is the core of this story. A generic status-page capability is adjacent to that requirement and does not count toward it.
